quit_any.label: Abandoned or suspended innovation activity (main exit outcome)
quit_any.rule: quit_any = 1 if IA3 == yes, 0 if IA3 == no; defined only for firms with any innovation activity (IA1..IA6 any yes); recoded to printed yes=1/no=0 first

exit_strict.label: Abandoned without any completed activity
exit_strict.rule: exit_strict = 1 if IA3 == yes and IA1 == no, else 0; same population as quit_any

exit_full.label: Abandoned with neither completed nor ongoing activity
exit_full.rule: exit_full = 1 if IA3 == yes and IA1 == no and IA2 == no, else 0; same population as quit_any

preempt_strategy.label: Protected products by entering the market ahead of competitors (lead-time; main preemption outcome)
preempt_strategy.rule: preempt_strategy = PROT8 recoded yes=1/no=0; all firms

market_first.label: New-to-market product innovation (secondary preemption outcome)
market_first.rule: market_first = MF1 recoded yes=1/no=0 among product innovators (PI1 or PI2 == yes); missing for non-innovators (selection handled separately)

entry_threat.label: Perceived threat of entry by new competitors
entry_threat.rule: ME4 on printed 0-5 scale (0 = does not apply); after wave-specific recode

rival_unpredictability.label: Competitors' actions are difficult to predict (observation noise proxy)

placebo_demand.label: Placebo: changes in demand difficult to predict

placebo_price.label: Placebo: price increases lead to loss of customers

tech_uncertainty.label: Future technological developments difficult to predict (control)

rd_staff_share.label: Share of dedicated R&D staff among regular employees (main technology-gap proxy)
rd_staff_share.rule: percentage 0-100 as reported; ranked within industry (2-digit) x wave for the gap tercile

rd_intensity.label: R&D expenditure / sales (secondary gap proxy, innovation-active firms only)
rd_intensity.rule: RDEXP / SALES, both million KRW, reference calendar year; defined only where IA1..IA6 any yes and SALES > 0

export_share.label: Exports / sales in the reference year
export_share.rule: EXPORTS / SALES; exports missing treated as 0 only where the questionnaire blank means no exports — verified in Task 3 against value distribution, otherwise missing

masters_share.label: Share of employees with a master's degree or higher

cert_venture.label: Venture-firm certification
cert_venture.rule: 1 if the multi-response column is ticked (value == item code), else 0

cert_rd_institute.label: Registered R&D institute / dedicated R&D department

group_affiliate.label: Firm type: independent / domestic-group affiliate / foreign-group affiliate

legal_size.label: Statutory firm size class
legal_size.rule: categorical 1 small / 2 medium / 3 mid-sized / 4 large as printed

listed.label: Stock-market listing
listed.rule: 1 if KOSPI/KOSDAQ/KONEX (codes 1-3), 0 if '해당사항 없음' (code 4 or data sentinel 9998)

portfolio_breadth.label: Number of innovation-activity types reported (portfolio-size control)
portfolio_breadth.rule: count of yes among IA1, IA2, IA4, IA5, IA6 (IA3 excluded because it is the outcome)

rd_continuous.label: In-house R&D performed continuously (vs occasionally)
rd_continuous.rule: 1 if RDCYCLE == 1, 0 if RDCYCLE == 2; missing where IA4 == no

funding_public_attempt.label: Attempted central- or local-government funding
funding_public_attempt.rule: 1 if FUND7 or FUND8 on printed scale >= 1 (attempted), else 0

hamp_weak_competition.label: Reason not to innovate: weak competitive pressure (auxiliary)

employees.label: Regular employees in the reference year

firm_age.label: Firm age in the reference year

female_share.label: Share of women among regular employees (%)
